description: This PHP source file defines the class TemplateRelatedTextField, which extends TemplateText and provides custom rendering and handling for a related text field in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for generating HTML for editing, viewing, searching, and listing related record fields, as well as handling saving, deletion, and label management for related fields.

classes.name: TemplateRelatedTextField
classes.description: A class extending TemplateText to manage related text fields with custom HTML rendering and label management in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML code for editing the related text field with popup selection functionality.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns HTML link for displaying related record detail view.

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Returns a placeholder for list view display of the related field.

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Returns HTML for search interface, either a select dropdown or edit field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Provides data for search template, including handling team selection and popup request data.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Provides data for editing view, including popup request configuration.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns data similar to get_xtpl_edit for detail view.

methods.name: get_related_info
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving related record info (empty implementation).

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including related module info and search settings.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of the field and associated label labels.

methods.name: deleteIdLabel
methods.description: Removes labels associated with the ID field for related records.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the related field, creating associated ID fields if necessary.

methods.name: saveIdLabel
methods.description: Saves label for the ID field associated with the relation.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, placeholder for database alter statements.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, placeholder for database alter statements.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, placeholder for database alter statements.
